prompt:
Task / size class:
Loop 067 — bounded MEDIUM docs/tests-only Claude account-auth read-only checklist.

Goal:
Prepare one machine-checkable STATIC/read-only inspection contract for the Anthropic/Claude `claude_account_auth` gap. Define exactly what a future separately authorized read-only inspection would have to observe to establish that the intended account/claude.ai subscription-auth route remains the observed route, without sending any provider/model turn, revealing credentials, changing authentication/settings/billing/permissions, or claiming the route is already proven.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_SUBSCRIPTION_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_TO_LIVE_GAP_AUDIT.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_MINIMUM_PERMISSIONS_STATIC_INVENTORY.md
- src/providers/claude_acp.py
- src/providers/preflight.py
- src/providers/policy.py
- fixtures/relay/acp_initialize_account.json
- existing related Relay tests before writing new assertions

Allowed changed paths only:
- docs/RELAY_CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_AUTH_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
- tests/relay/test_claude_account_auth_readonly_checklist.py
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- docs/tests/checkpoint only
- no src/ production code changes
- no workflow/schema/dependency/lockfile changes
- no provider/model/account/billing API or network call
- no real provider/model turn
- no login/logout/authentication mutation
- no credential/token/cookie/account-number/payment-instrument disclosure or dump
- no API-key route enablement or inspection of raw API-key values
- no billing/credits/overages/settings/permissions mutation
- do not use or recommend --hide-claude-auth for the intended subscription route
- no Merge
- no rebase, force push, branch deletion, merge commit, or conflict auto-resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- do not mark claude_account_auth or common_subscription_route PASS/VERIFIED/RESOLVED/READY
- if real account/runtime observation is required, leave it EVIDENCE_REQUIRED/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN

Existing implementation to reuse:
- Treat the generic subscription-route checklist, gap audit, live evidence plan, live blockers, minimum-permissions inventory, Claude static profile, preflight, and policy as authoritative.
- Reuse existing checked-in static facts rather than recreating provider policy or fixtures.
- Static required_auth_kind=account, hide_claude_auth=false guard behavior, a successful login label, or a repository-only absence of API keys must never be reinterpreted as proof of the actual runtime identity or subscription charging route.
- Do not duplicate or weaken accepted generic subscription-route semantics.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_AUTH_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md as PREPARED/static read-only inspection plan only.
2. Scope exactly one provider/gap: provider_id=anthropic and gap_id=claude_account_auth.
3. Define one machine-checkable current-state row with at least:
   provider_id, gap_id, static_expected_auth_kind_state, static_hide_auth_guard_state,
   observed_authenticated_identity_state, observed_credential_kind_state,
   observed_subscription_route_state, api_key_absence_state,
   readonly_inspection_state, evidence_provenance_state, blocker_state.
4. Allowed current-state vocabulary only:
   STATIC_PREPARED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
5. The two checked-in/static guard fields may be STATIC_PREPARED. All real account/credential/subscription/API-key/provenance observations remain EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or UNKNOWN. blocker_state remains BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
6. Explicitly distinguish:
   - checked-in required auth kind `account`;
   - checked-in `hide_claude_auth=false` guard behavior;
   - actual observed authenticated identity class;
   - actual observed credential mechanism/kind;
   - actual observed claude.ai/subscription route;
   - proof that no alternate API-key route is selected at runtime;
   - proof event identity and evidence provenance.
7. State that static config/profile/default values, a successful login/account label, or repository-only absence of API-key material are individually insufficient to prove the actual account/subscription route.
8. Preserve the current blocker rule that `--hide-claude-auth` is incompatible with the intended claude.ai subscription route and must not be used as a proof shortcut.
9. Define future conceptual read-only evidence fields:
   provider_id, gap_id, inspection_correlation_id, intended_auth_kind,
   observed_auth_kind, observed_identity_class, hide_claude_auth_observation,
   api_key_route_state, subscription_route_observation, evidence_source,
   evidence_locator_or_hash, captured_at, verification_state.
10. No raw secrets, tokens, cookies, passwords, account numbers, billing identifiers, payment instrument data, or full private profile dumps belong in evidence.
11. Evidence must be Anthropic/inspection-event bound; evidence from OpenAI, Google, another account, or another inspection cannot satisfy this gap.
12. Fail closed / remain BLOCKED_UNKNOWN when any of these are unknown, ambiguous, conflicting, or unverifiable:
   observed auth kind, observed identity class, credential mechanism, hide-claude-auth state,
   API-key route absence, subscription route ownership, evidence provenance,
   exact provider/inspection binding.
13. If proof would require sending a model/provider turn, reading a raw secret, changing login/auth/settings/permissions/billing, or enabling an alternate paid route, that proof method is outside this batch and forbidden.
14. State that zero external/read-only account evidence is acquired by this batch.
15. State that claude_account_auth remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
16. Update docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static Claude account-auth checklist status only; do not resolve any live blocker.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- exact provider_id anthropic and gap_id claude_account_auth
- exactly one current-state provider row
- allowed state vocabulary is not widened
- static account/hide-auth guards cannot satisfy observed identity or subscription-route fields
- successful login/account label alone is insufficient
- repository-only API-key absence alone is insufficient
- unknown or ambiguous observed auth/identity/credential/subscription route fails closed
- hide_claude_auth unknown/true cannot become proof of intended subscription route
- cross-provider/cross-inspection evidence cannot satisfy this gap
- raw secrets/private account/payment data are forbidden from evidence
- all conceptual evidence field names are present
- zero external/read-only evidence acquired in this batch
- claude_account_auth remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
- checkpoint preserves the same boundary
- no vacuous tests

Acceptance criteria:
- exact allowed-path fence holds
- production/workflow/schema code unchanged
- direct assertions cover all required semantics and negative cases
- no provider/model/API/network/account/auth/settings/billing/permission action
- no live readiness or execution authorization is created
- retry=0 and fallback disabled remain explicit
- full Relay validation is green

Exact validation commands:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

Publication condition:
Create the normal isolated Jules PR only if the exact path fence holds and all required validation is green. Do not Merge.

Explicit stop conditions:
Stop instead of guessing if:
- any real provider/model/account/billing API or network call would be required
- raw credentials/secrets/private account/payment data would need inspection or storage
- login/auth/settings/permissions/billing state would need mutation
- src/, workflow, schema, dependency, or lockfile changes are required
- current generic subscription-route semantics would need weakening
- provider-specific runtime behavior would need to be invented
- fail-closed BLOCKED_UNKNOWN semantics would need weakening
